brains/lake-brain.healthRule: FAILED: write failed or no lakes. DEGRADED: > 25 % of reviewed lakes unavailable. WARNING: any reviewed lake stale, unavailable or on a fallback source. HEALTHY otherwise.

recomputeWhen: profileHash differs from the published one

lakeState.staleness: time-based: stale when the source is more than two cadences past due, or the published state is older than 3 h

speciesPresence.staleness: version-based: researchVersion / fingerprint; never by age

orchestration.schedule: none: run on demand, or when the future Sector Brain Orchestrator decides (no Lake-specific cron)

brains/lake-brain.question: What does Sector know about this particular lake: its water level now, against its own history and operator guide, and which fish are recorded there?

readinessDefinitions.BETA: Current level from a reviewed source, operator guide and ≥ 5 complete years of history: every classification computed. Not yet validated.
readinessDefinitions.CALIBRATION: Current level from a reviewed source; history < 5 complete years or no operator guide, so some classifications are withheld.
readinessDefinitions.DEGRADED: Reviewed source, but the current reading is stale or unavailable (last known value kept and flagged).
readinessDefinitions.DISCOVERED: Directory lake; no reviewed water-level source binding yet. Profile only.
readinessDefinitions.PROFILED: Reviewed binding says no usable level source.
readinessDefinitions.VALIDATED: Not used until classification checks exist.

schedule.cadence: manual (on demand; no Lake-specific cron — the Orchestrator will own cadence)

stateKindDefinitions.OBSERVED: Operator pool elevation or an on-lake surface-elevation gauge.
stateKindDefinitions.PROXY: A nearby gage height or river stage. Trend only: never a level state, percentile or pool difference.
stateKindDefinitions.UNAVAILABLE: No reading from any reviewed source.

versions.note: Rules v2 (pre-registered): history tiers gate VERY_UNUSUAL (≥ 15 years), trend from the 72 h mean (floors 0.10 / 0.05 ft), RAPID = max(seasonal p95 |Δ24h|, 0.25 ft). baselineStatus (≥ 5 years SUFFICIENT) and NOT_VALIDATED unchanged.
